messages.author: 75e0b0abcbafbc7d
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] gof_ds fails to produce the Q-Q plot
parts:
Asier

Thanks for your question. One of the facets of your study that you don't describe is the manner in which the data were recorded. Did you record exact radial distances to the detection, or did you record detection distances in bins (0-10, 10-20, ...)? If it was the former, you should obtain a QQ plot. If it was the latter (binned distances) QQ plots (and tests) will not be produced. QQ plots can only be created for exact distance data.

If you did record data as exact distances, gof_ds() should be able to produce a QQ plot; if that is the case, you might need to send your data and code off-line for further investigation.
